description: This file is a source HTML file with embedded JavaScript that provides a user interface for inserting and configuring images in a TinyMCE editor plugin's advanced theme.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initialization function called on page load, via tinyMCEPopup.executeOnLoad.

methods.name: insertImage()
methods.description: Function invoked to insert the configured image into the editor, triggered by the 'Insert' button.

methods.name: getImageData()
methods.description: Extracts image data from the form fields, called when relevant form fields change.

methods.name: resetImageData()
methods.description: Resets the image data forms, called when a new image is selected from the list.
